metadata.title: 业务逻辑测试修复和状态管理优化

story.iWant: 修复业务逻辑测试失败并优化组件状态管理
story.soThat: 确保用户界面功能稳定可靠并提升代码质量
story.tasks: 5 major tasks covering localStorage test fixes, component state management optimization, user interaction logic testing, theme/style management testing, and state management best practices establishment

story-context.acceptanceCriteria: 1. 修复localStorage数据持久化测试 - UserPreferences组件localStorage相关测试100%通过 2. 解决组件状态管理问题 - 组件状态更新和同步逻辑正确，测试通过率≥90% 3. 优化用户交互逻辑测试 - 复杂操作流程和数据验证测试完整通过 4. 修复主题和样式管理测试 - CSS类名和主题切换逻辑稳定 5. 建立状态管理最佳实践 - 制定组件状态管理和测试标准

constraints.constraint: Local State First: Use React useState for component-local state management
State Synchronization: Implement proper useEffect dependencies to prevent stale closures
Error Boundaries: Wrap state management in try-catch blocks for error resilience
State Immutability: Always treat state as immutable, use functional updates
Test Layering Strategy: 70% Unit Tests, 20% Integration Tests, 10% E2E Tests
Unit Test Requirements: Jest + React Testing Library, 90%+ coverage, <100ms per test
State updates should be optimized to prevent unnecessary re-renders
localStorage operations should be debounced where appropriate
No external state management libraries (Redux, Zustand, etc.) for local component state
